message.content:
**rs7412 (APOE) – allele frequency in European populations**

| Source | Population | Minor allele (T) frequency |
|--------|------------|-----------------------------|
| **gnomAD v2.1.1** | Non‑Finnish Europeans (N ≈ 60 000) | **≈ 0.11 (11 %)** |
| **gnomAD v3.1.1** | European (EUR) superpopulation (N ≈ 60 000) | **≈ 0.10–0.12 (10–12 %)** |
| **1000 Genomes Project** | European (EUR) (N ≈ 503) | **≈ 0.09–0.13 (9–13 %)** |

> **Interpretation**  
> The rs7412 SNP is one of the two key variants that define the APOE ε2, ε3, and ε4 alleles. In most European cohorts the minor allele (T) occurs at roughly 10–12 % of chromosomes, giving an ε2 allele frequency of about 10 % (the ε2 allele is defined by the combination of rs429358 C and rs7412 T). Frequencies can vary slightly among sub‑populations (e.g., higher in Southern Europeans, lower in Northern Europeans), but the overall range remains close to 10–12 %.

**Key references**

1. **gnomAD Browser** – allele frequencies for rs7412 (https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/variant/rs7412).  
2. **1000 Genomes Project** – Phase 3 data (https://www.internationalgenome.org/data).  
3. **Allele Frequency Net Database** – APOE SNPs in European populations (https://www.allelefrequencies.net/).

If you need the exact numbers for a specific sub‑population (e.g., Finnish, British, Italian), let me know and I can pull the precise figures from the relevant dataset.
